settings.helpers.menu.title: Helpers
settings.helpers.menu.label: Helpers Settings
settings.helpers.menu.hint: Small reusable functions for macros, on MacroHelper and on tokens, actors and items.
settings.helperMethods.title: Methods on Tokens, Actors & Items
settings.helperMethods.hint: Adds the helpers as methods, e.g. token.distanceTo(other). Needs a reload.
settings.rangeShape.title: Range Shape
settings.rangeShape.hint: Circle : true distance. Square : 5e rule, diagonals are 5 ft.
settings.conditionAttacks.title: Conditions on Attack Rolls
settings.conditionAttacks.hint: Poisoned (and similar) gives disadvantage on attack rolls.
settings.itemMacro.menu.title: Item Macro
settings.itemMacro.menu.label: Item Macro Settings
settings.itemMacro.menu.hint: Macros stored on items and activities, run when they are used.
settings.itemMacro.title: Enabled
settings.itemMacro.hint: Store macros on items and activities, run when used.
settings.itemMacroPlayers.title: Players Can Edit Item Macros
settings.itemMacroPlayers.hint: Off : only GMs can add or change item macros.
settings.itemMacroTitleBar.title: Button in Title Bar
settings.itemMacroTitleBar.hint: Item Macro button in the sheet title bar (else the ⋯ menu).
settings.hookMacros.menu.title: Hook Macros
settings.hookMacros.menu.label: Hook Macros Settings
settings.hookMacros.menu.hint: Run world macros when something happens in the game (world loaded, turn changed, token moved...), set from each macro's config.
settings.hookMacros.title: Enabled
settings.hookMacros.hint: World macros can run on hooks (GM only).
settings.rollItem.menu.title: Roll Item
settings.rollItem.menu.label: Roll Item Settings
settings.rollItem.menu.hint: One-click dnd5e roll cards : attacks, saves, heals, damage and utility rolls.
settings.rollItem.title: Enabled
settings.rollItemDefault.title: Attacks
settings.rollItemDefault.hint: Attacks post a Roll Item card instead of dnd5e's.
settings.rollItemSaves.title: Saves
settings.rollItemSaves.hint: Save activities roll their damage onto the card, one row per target.
settings.rollItemHeals.title: Heals
settings.rollItemHeals.hint: Heal activities roll their healing onto the card.
settings.rollItemDamage.title: Damage
settings.rollItemDamage.hint: Damage-only activities roll onto the card.
settings.rollItemUtility.title: Utility
settings.rollItemUtility.hint: Utility activities with a formula roll onto the card.
settings.rollItemPick.title: Pick Targets
settings.rollItemPick.hint: Click targets on the map before rolling, with the range shown.
settings.rollItemPick.empty: When you have no targets in range
settings.homebrew.menu.title: Homebrew
settings.homebrew.menu.label: Homebrew
settings.homebrew.menu.hint: Table rules that aren't in the books. All off by default.
settings.homebrewFlanking.title: Flanking
settings.homebrewFlanking.hint: Melee attacks with an ally on the target's far side.
settings.homebrewPush.title: Push Into Obstacles
settings.homebrewPush.hint: A push cut short by a wall or creature : Prone, and 1d6 if it didn't move.
settings.rollItemStaged.title: Damage After the Attack
settings.rollItemStaged.hint: Show the attack roll, then the damage once its dice land.
settings.rollItemMasteries.title: Weapon Mastery
rollItem.mastery.effect.sap: Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of the attacker's next turn.
rollItem.mastery.effect.slow: Speed reduced by 10 feet until the start of the attacker's next turn.
rollItem.mastery.effect.vex: Advantage on the next attack roll against this creature before the end of your next turn.
rollItem.mastery.used: That mastery has already been used for this attack.
rollItem.mastery.noHit: The attack didn't hit any of the card's targets.
rollItem.mastery.tooBig: {name} is too big to push (Huge or larger).
rollItem.mastery.cleaveOnce: Cleave can only be used once per turn.
gm.none: No GM is online to do that.
settings.rollItemAdvantage.title: Advantage / Disadvantage
settings.rollItemAdvantage.hint: How advantage or disadvantage is chosen, for Roll Item, rerolls, and sheet checks, saves and initiative (no dnd5e dialog unless asking).
settings.rollItemAdvantage.keys: Hold dnd5e's keys while rolling (default Alt / Ctrl)
settings.rollItemAdvantage.prompt: Ask before rolling (after targets are picked)
settings.rollItemAdvantage.none: Neither : only what the rules give
rollItem.maneuver.tooBig: {name} is too big to {action} (more than one size larger).
rollItem.maneuver.notFailed: That creature hasn't failed its save against this shove.
rollItem.maneuver.done: That creature has already been shoved.
settings.rollItemManeuvers.title: Grapple & Shove
settings.rollItemManeuvers.hint: Grapple applies Grappled; Shove offers Prone or Push 5 ft.
rollItem.mode.title: Attack Roll
rollItem.mode.hint: Roll with advantage, normally or with disadvantage ? Long range, conditions and masteries are added on top.
settings.debug.title: Debug
settings.debug.hint: Extra logging in the browser console.
itemMacro.title: Item Macro
itemMacro.mode.label: When Used
itemMacro.mode.hint: What happens when this is used. In "Macro, then Default" the macro can return false to skip the default.
itemMacro.hooks.runAsHint: Owner : on the client where the hook fires, if that user owns the creature (damage about to apply only fires for whoever applies it). Active GM : for hooks that fire for everyone (actor changed, combat turn).
itemMacro.hooks.selfHint: Run only when the hook is about this creature (the damaged actor, its token, its turn...). Either way it only runs while the creature has a token on the scene you're viewing.
itemMacro.error.permission: You do not have permission to write script macros.
itemMacro.error.execute: Item macro failed, see the console (F12) for details.
hookMacros.hooks.dnd5e.preApplyDamage: Damage about to apply (can change it)
helpers.hp.notOwner: You don't have permission to change {name}'s hit points.
helpers.slots.title: Recover Spell Slots
helpers.slots.hint: Choose expended spell slots to recover : a combined level of up to {levels}, none above level {maxLevel}.
helpers.slots.none: {name} has no expended spell slots to recover.
helpers.multiattack.title: Multiattack
helpers.multiattack.hint: Up to {count} attacks, with any of these :
helpers.attack.noItem: run this from an item (as an Item Macro, or item.pickAndAttack()).
helpers.attack.itemFirst: the item goes first : MacroHelper.pickAndAttack(item, { ... }), or item.pickAndAttack({ ... }).
helpers.attack.noAttack: this item has no attack activity.
helpers.attack.cantUse: this attack can't be used right now.
helpers.attack.noActor: this item isn't on an actor.
helpers.attack.noToken: {name} has no token on this scene.
helpers.attack.noRange: this item has no range to attack in (Self or 0 ft).
helpers.attack.notEnoughThrown: {throws} of the targets are out of reach and need a throw, but there are only {quantity}.
helpers.attack.threatened: Threatened by {names} : ranged attacks have disadvantage.
helpers.attack.noRoll: the attack didn't roll, see the console (F12).
helpers.attack.error: something went wrong, see the console (F12).
helpers.pick.keys: Left click to pick or unpick · Enter to confirm · Esc to cancel
helpers.pick.keysRepeat: Left click to pick (again for another attack) · Right click to unpick · Enter to confirm · Esc to cancel
helpers.pick.legend: Blue : in range · Orange : can be picked · Green : picked
helpers.pick.legendLong: Blue : normal · Red : disadvantage (long range, or ranged while threatened) · Orange : can be picked · Green : picked
helpers.pick.noToken: No token on this scene to target from.
helpers.targets.title: Choose Targets
helpers.targets.hint: Blue is your range, orange who you can pick, green your picks. Click a portrait to find it on the map.
helpers.targets.tooMany: Too many : at most {allowed} for their size.
helpers.targets.apart: Targets must be within {within} ft of each other.
rollItem.apply.hits: Apply all hits to their targets
rollItem.apply.noTarget: No target to apply damage to : target or select a token you own.
rollItem.count.title: Attack Count
rollItem.count.label: Number of attack rolls
rollItem.count.hint: A number or formula. @scaling is the cantrip tier (1-4) or 1 + upcast levels. Scorching Ray: 2 + @scaling. Eldritch Blast: @scaling. Blank = 1.
rollItem.warn.disabled: Macro Helper: Roll Item is disabled in the module settings.
rollItem.warn.noAttack: {name} has nothing for Roll Item to roll (attack, save, damage, heal, or utility with a formula).
rollItem.error.type: Macro Helper: the roll card message type is not registered. Fully restart Foundry (not just the world) after updating the module.
hookMacros.hooks.macro-helper.preAttack: Before an attack roll (can change it)
hookMacros.hooks.macro-helper.preDamage: Before a damage roll (can change it)
hookMacros.hooks.dnd5e.preRollAttackV2: Before any attack roll (can change it)
hookMacros.hooks.dnd5e.preRollSavingThro: Before any saving throw (can change it)
settings.weaponRules.title: Weapon Property Rules
settings.weaponRules.hint: Heavy, hands, Loading, Light and equipped checks.
settings.rollItemTemplateTargets.title: Template Targeting
settings.rollItemTemplateTargets.hint: Target everyone inside a placed template.
rules.weapon.loading: {item} has Loading : one shot per turn, whatever the number of attacks.
rules.weapon.light: {item} : an off-hand attack needs an attack with a different Light weapon first this turn.
settings.weaponRules.change: Change (fix the equipment / grip, warn for the rest)
settings.rollItemDmScreen.title: DM Screen
settings.rollItemDmScreen.hint: Players see NPC cards without the numbers; hidden targets show as Unknown.
rules.weapon.oneHanded: {item} held one-handed (the other hand is busy).
rules.weapon.handsFull: No free hand for {item} : {items} in hand.
settings.traitRules.title: Species & Feat Rules
settings.traitRules.hint: Brave, Fey Ancestry, Dwarven Resilience, Savage Attacker, Alert, Lucky, Tavern Brawler, Healer.
feats.savage.used: {name} has already been used this turn.
feats.alert.title: Alert
feats.alert.hint: initiative {initiative}. Swap with a willing ally before the first turn passes ?
feats.alert.late: Too late : a turn has passed since initiative was rolled.
feats.alert.noAlly: That ally can't swap (not in the combat, or Incapacitated).
feats.lucky.same: That roll already has it : advantage and disadvantage don't stack.
feats.lucky.done: A Luck Point was already used against this attack.
feats.lucky.none: No attacked creature of yours has a Luck Point left.
feats.healer.noKit: Battle Medic needs a Healer's Kit with a use left.
feats.healer.noHitDie: {name} has no {die} Hit Die left to spend.
feats.healer.noHitDice: {name} has no Hit Dice left to spend.
feats.healer.chooseDie: {healer} uses Battle Medic on {name} : which Hit Die does {name} spend ?
rollItem.noTargetsLeft: None of the picked creatures can be affected.
settings.downedRules.title: Condition & Downed Rules
settings.downedRules.hint: Advantage against downed, restrained, stunned... targets; auto-crits within 5 ft; death save failures from damage at 0 HP.
feats.alert.askHint: {a} (Alert) wants to swap initiative with {b} : {b} would go on {mine}, {a} on {theirs}.
feats.alert.declined: No swap : {b}'s player declined (or didn't answer).
settings.autoInitiative.title: Auto-Roll Initiative
settings.autoInitiative.hint: When combat begins, everyone who hasn't rolled initiative rolls.
settings.homebrewInitiative.title: Initiative Each Round
settings.homebrewInitiative.hint: Everyone rolls initiative again at the start of every round.
reasons.threatened: ranged attack while an enemy is within 5 ft
rollItem.apply.already: Already applied to {name} from this card. Adjust HP by hand to change it.
rollItem.maneuver.choose: Grapple or Shove ? The target makes the save either way, there's no attack roll.
settings.actionRules.title: Dodge & Help
settings.actionRules.hint: The Dodge and Help items (examples/items) : Dodging, Assist Attack, Assist Check, Stabilize.
actions.help.chooseCheck: Which of your proficiencies does your ally get advantage with ?
actions.help.noProficiency: {name} has no skill or tool proficiency to help with.
settings.visionRules.title: Vision Rules
settings.visionRules.hint: By each token's own sight : can't pick what it can't see; unseen attackers and targets; threats and Dodge need to see you.
reasons.unseenAttacker: the target can't see the attacker
cover.title: Cover (GM)
cover.half: Half cover : +2 AC and DEX saves
cover.threeQuarters: Three-quarters cover : +5 AC and DEX saves
helpers.pick.legendModes: Green : advantage · Yellow : normal · Red : disadvantage · Squares : blue in range, red long range
actions.help.noteAttack: Assist Attack against {name} : an ally's next attack has advantage.
actions.help.noteCheck: Assist Check : {name} has advantage on their next {check} check.
